problem: Generic AI-model comparison pages are too shallow for business decisions and become stale quickly.
decision: Create one canonical Model Advisor that combines goal-fit, workload cost, provider lifecycle, provenance, governance and data-sovereignty evidence, and routes optional qualified leads into the existing commercial outcome loop.
context: AI model selection must combine workload fit, current provider evidence, price, lifecycle, governance and data sovereignty instead of generic benchmark ranking.
root_cause: Generic comparison content becomes stale and can recommend technically strong models that violate workload economics or governance constraints.
prevention_rules: Official source + verification date required for price/lifecycle
No lead gate before useful advice
No parallel CRM or revenue store
Model changes enter as candidates until verified
truth_boundary: Recommendation scores are workload-fit heuristics; pricing, lifecycle and governance become decision evidence only when backed by current official-source verification.
